Support Our Work

Help carry community care forward.

Your support can help Aashray build on its beginnings and prepare for the next stage of its work. Tell us how you would like to contribute, and our team will explain the arrangements available.

01 / Support Our Work

Ways to support

Program support — Discuss an area of work you would like to help develop.

Material support — Ask about useful items or resources before arranging a contribution.

Professional support — Contribute skills, guidance or expertise through a volunteer or partnership enquiry.

Financial support — Contact the team for confirmed arrangements and information about contribution records.

Choose an area of interest

Community & Relief; Health & Wellbeing; Upcoming Computer Training; Future Initiatives; Where Support Is Needed.

An expression of interest helps us understand your preference. Any restricted use of funds must be agreed before a contribution is accepted.
